{{Top}}
[[File:BrentaalFuneral-XWRS26.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The funeral for fallen New Republic pilots following the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]]]]
A '''funeral''' was a ceremony held following the death of an individual amongst the various cultures of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Funeral customs varied widely based on the culture and beliefs of the deceased individual. Groups such as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] also had their own special funeral customs. Funerals were held usually just before the final disposition of a person's remains, which was often [[Burial/Legends|burial]] or [[Cremation/Legends|cremation]]. In most cases the person's body was present at the funeral, unless their body was destroyed, could not be retrieved, or in the case of the Jedi became [[Force ghost/Legends|discorporeal]] after death.

==Cultures==
The [[Naboo (people)/Legends|people]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] believed that the body of a deceased must be cremated within two days time in order to return the deceased's spirit to the planet. A popular location for Naboo funerals was the [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] [[Theed Funeral Temple/Legends|Funeral Temple]], near the banks of the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] remains were cremated in this temple after his death in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. For important individuals, a procession through the streets of Theed was part of the funeral service. After her death in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the body of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was carried in a procession through Theed.

The Gran had their own funeral customs. [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]] was given such a funeral after his death in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], which was disrupted by [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] activists.

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had their [[Jedi funeral/Legends|own]] funeral customs for deceased Jedi following their deaths. This most often involved cremating the deceased on a pyre. From time to time the Jedi also practiced [[Burial/Legends|burial]].

On [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], the government rehearsed the state funeral ceremonies of certain [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] leaders on a regular basis. By [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], as [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] was over 90 years old, the government of Bastion regularly rehearsed his funeral. Pellaeon witnessed these rehearsals and found it sobering to witness his own funeral.
